$comment: The gate, as an OPT-IN settings file rather than as .claude/settings.json.
Two reasons it is not the latter. The gate loads live, in the session that
writes it, while an MCP server is read once at session start -- so writing
the gate into the active settings file gives that session the denials
without the mediated path they redirect to, including the Write needed to
undo it. And this repo is built with cargo and committed with git, both of
which are host Bash: under its own gate, the checkout cannot develop itself.
Turn it on for a session that should be mediated:
Register the MCP server and restart FIRST -- see the README's Install order.
If a session is ever stranded with no working tool, `!` at the prompt runs a
command outside the hooks: `! git checkout .claude/settings.json`.
